Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered list or custom sort order over and over, this update is for you. Now you can capture any configuration of filters, grouping, and sorting as a named view you can return to instantly, without re-creating it from scratch each time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, sprint backlogs, or work assigned to a specific teammate, there's room to organize your workflow exactly how you like it. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align everyone around the same prioritized list, status board, or reporting cutoff, without asking colleagues to manually rebuild your setup.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates automatically as your data changes, so shared views always reflect the current state of your projects. Team members with access can jump straight into a shared view from the sidebar.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
